investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-10T12:35–12:36Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB endpoint at /v1/agents was unreachable during agent provisioning. investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed upstream that the production-api proxies agent provisioning requests to at /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every attempt. Because all three sibling checks share the same first step (POST /api/agents → swarm gateway), the failure is localized to that shared upstream dependency, not to any individual check's logic. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability signal; no user-traffic or incident evidence is present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.

investigations.summary: The eval for the published-observability-snapshot check failed because the snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json was 698 minutes old at eval time, more than double the 300-minute maximum enforced by the expected-output contract. All other public-website sibling checks passed, isolating the failure entirely to the staleness of the published snapshot artifact, not to the website's availability or any shared infrastructure dependency.
investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json did not run successfully within the required 300-minute window. The snapshot served at eval time was 698 minutes old (evidence id: failed-check.evidence), violating the snapshotAgeMinutes <= 300 assertion defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 482. This is an eval-detected staleness condition scoped to the snapshot publication pipeline; no evidence of a user-facing website outage is present, and no traffic or incident signals were supplied.

The evidence shows source='github-actions' and hasLiveSource=true, meaning the snapshot structure is valid but simply not refreshed.
